title: PT2 — Earth Materials in My Community: Field Survey & Industry Report
shortTitle: PT2 — Earth Materials in My Community
summary: Conduct a field survey of earth materials used in your community, then write a report analyzing how rocks, minerals, and soils are harnessed by local industries.
instructions:
Your task is to conduct a field survey of the earth materials used in your community and write a report on how they are harnessed by local industries. You will:

  1. Identify at least 5 examples of earth materials being used in your community. Examples:
    • Rocks — granite, marble, limestone in buildings, walls, or bridges
    • Minerals — copper wires, gold jewelry, silica in glass, salt (halite)
    • Soils — loam in gardens or farms, clay in pottery or bricks
    • Aggregates — sand, gravel, cement in construction
  2. For each material, take a photo and record:
    • Where you found it (specific location)
    • How it's being used (industry or purpose)
    • What rock type, mineral, or soil type it belongs to
    • Whether it is locally sourced or imported
  3. Write a 2–3 page report covering:
    • Classification of each material (igneous/sedimentary/metamorphic rock; specific mineral; soil type)
    • How the material is extracted or collected
    • Environmental impact of its use or extraction in your community
    • Sustainable alternatives or practices
  4. Create a community map or infographic showing where these materials are used.
  5. Reflect on how dependent your community is on earth materials and what could happen if they became scarce.

Format: Submit as PDF report + photos + community map/infographic. You may also create a video walk-through.
requirements: At least 5 examples of earth materials used in your community
Photo of each material in its real context
Location and description of how it's used
Community map or infographic showing material uses
options: Written PDF report + photos + community map
Video walk-through (5–8 minutes) with the same content
Digital infographic or poster (PDF or image)

rubric.criterion: Number and variety of earth materials identified (5+)
Quality of field survey (photos + accurate descriptions)
Depth of report on extraction, use, and impact
Quality of community map or infographic
